import openpyxl, os
out=os.environ['OUT_XLSX']
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(out)
ws=wb['Calc']
ws['B7']='=IF(COUNTIF(Supplier_1!A:A,$A$10)>0,"Supplier_1",IF(COUNTIF(Supplier_2!A:A,$A$10)>0,"Supplier_2",IF(COUNTIF(Supplier_3!A:A,$A$10)>0,"Supplier_3","")))'
wb.save(out)
print('done')
